candidates.source_title: Why Are These Strange Grids Spread Across the Desert
candidates.source_description:
Why Are These Strange Grids Spread Across the Desert? 🏜️🤯

These aren’t random patterns or decorations! In parts of Inner Mongolia, straw checkerboard grids are used to slow down wind and reduce the movement of sand. 🌾💨 Once the sand becomes more stable, drought-resistant grasses and shrubs can be planted, helping their roots hold the soil in place and reduce desertification.

A simple-looking technique that can make a big difference in protecting fragile land! 🌱🏜️
